definitions.explanation: People who have been killed or injured in an accident, disaster, attack, or conflict. Encompasses both fatalities and those who survived with injuries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死傷者|ししょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
{死傷者|ししょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The number of casualties has not yet been confirmed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{死傷者|ししょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百人以上|ひゃくにんいじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧のぼる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{報|ほう}じられた→報じる：17193_houjiru⟧。
examples.english: It was reported that the casualties from the earthquake exceeded one hundred people.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death) + {傷|しょう} (injury) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Very common in news reporting about disasters, accidents, and conflicts. The term covers both the dead and the injured collectively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死傷者|ししょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: casualties occur
- {死傷者|ししょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧: number of casualties
- {死傷者|ししょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: casualties increase
- ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死傷者|ししょうしゃ}: numerous casualties
- {死傷者|ししょうしゃ}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: zero casualties

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧: victim (broader; can include non-physical harm; carries a tone of sacrifice or injustice)
- ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧: victim, affected person (used in legal and crime contexts, not limited to physical injury)
- ⟦{負傷者|ふしょうしゃ}→負傷者：27169_fushousha⟧: the injured (only those who were wounded, not killed)
- ⟦{死者|ししゃ}→死者：13225_shisha⟧: the dead (only those who died)
